The tenant-audit census page totals every write site in prose, so two PRs that each add a write site collide on that page. Sharding the page and dropping the prose totals removes a recurring same-file conflict. This passes the tooling gate as fleet-throughput work (maintainer addendum 7, 「33941 影响车队的效率啊」, the same family as hot-file card A): **p2**, confirmed. Area o2-C may take it after #34531 lands (same-file serial).
